# Android Agent Skills

This directory contains the 34 GitHub-adapted Android skills from [`krutikJain/android-agent-skills`](https://github.com/krutikJain/android-agent-skills), pinned to upstream commit `c5bf6731b8441019418784484cca1578413e6ad3`.

Each skill is in its own directory with a `SKILL.md`; adjacent `references/`, `scripts/`, and `agents/` content is retained where provided upstream. The upstream MIT license is preserved at [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/android-agent-skills-LICENSE.txt`](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/android-agent-skills-LICENSE.txt).

Skills should be selected based on the task. This project primarily benefits from the Compose, Coroutines/Flow, Room, Android security, storage/files, testing, and CI/CD skills. The remaining skills are retained for future Android work.
